questions.text: Describe a mountain or hill you have visited or would like to visit.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a mountain or hill you have visited or would like to visit. You should say: where it is; what it looks like; what people can do there; and explain why you would like to go there, or why you enjoyed your visit.

questions.text: Do many people in your country enjoy walking in the mountains?
questions.say: Thank you. Do many people in your country enjoy walking in the mountains?

questions.text: Why do many people like to spend their holidays in natural places?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a mountain or hill, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all nature and holidays. Why do many people like to spend their holidays in natural places?

questions.text: Do you think people today spend less time in nature than in the past?
questions.say: Do you think people today spend less time in nature than in the past?

questions.text: Should schools take children out into nature more often?

questions.text: How can tourism damage natural places such as mountains and forests?
questions.say: Now let's talk about protecting natural places. How can tourism damage natural places such as mountains and forests?

questions.text: Should the number of visitors to popular natural places be limited?
questions.say: Should the number of visitors to popular natural places be limited?
